signals.name: Advanced Micro Devices

On AltIndex's Oct 7, 2026 WallStreetBets tracker, AMD had 120 mentions with bullish sentiment (+26.8% day-over-day). Rep. Josh Gottheimer had disclosed AMD buys earlier in 2026.
signals.takeaway: Analyst upgrade and retail enthusiasm are aligned this week, but the congressional leg is months stale and the stock is already flagged as richly valued, so this looks like a momentum chase rather than fresh insider-adjacent conviction.

Rep. Gilbert Cisneros (House Armed Services) has repeatedly traded PLTR -- buys disclosed Nov 7/18 and a sale disclosed Jun 8, 2026 -- drawing attention given Palantir's defense-contractor profile. Fresh this run: PLTR carried the most bearish sentiment of any ticker on AltIndex's Oct 9, 2026 WallStreetBets tracker (67 bearish mentions), a notable retail-sentiment divergence from the institutional buying above.
signals.takeaway: Institutional conviction (especially Millennium's outsized add) and a defense-committee member's repeated trading in a defense-AI name both point toward sustained interest, but Cisneros has traded both directions so the congressional signal is more pattern than directional conviction, and retail sentiment on WSB has now turned the most bearish of any tracked ticker -- a genuine cross-current rather than a one-sided convergence.

signals.name: Vistra Corp
